h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhidham

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhidham

items.pText: Gandhidham was built to serve the port at Kandla, and its townships, schools and housing colonies sit on flat, dry Kutch ground close to the sea. Salt in the air and in the soil is the biggest challenge for outdoor equipment here. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment from our factory in Vasai, about 500 km away, and sends it to Kutch by road.

Bare steel rusts quickly in this setting, and painted metal starts to bubble within a few seasons. Galvanised pipe has a zinc coating that protects the steel, and roto-moulded plastic does not corrode. Summers are long and very hot, rainfall is low and dust storms are common, so we also plan shade and surfaces with care. Send us a site plan or photos and we will mark the safe play area on our layout.

richText.heading: Dealing with saline soil and salt air

c: Saline ground attacks concrete and any steel buried in it. Where we grout equipment, the posts should sit in a well-made concrete base, finished so that water runs off rather than pooling around the post. Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to wash off salt deposits, and check fixings and bolts as part of routine maintenance. Rubber flooring is easier to keep clean than sand in a dusty area.

items.q: Does playground equipment rust in Gandhidham's salty air?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist salt air far better than painted steel. Rinsing the equipment with fresh water now and then stops salt deposits from building up.

items.q: Do you supply port and industrial townships in Kutch?
items.a: Yes. We supply townships, schools and housing colonies across Kutch and the rest of Gujarat, delivering from Vasai by road and installing with our team or a dealer.

items.q: What maintenance does the equipment need near the coast?
items.a: Rinse it with fresh water, tighten loose bolts and check springs and bearings regularly. Our after-sales team can share a simple maintenance routine at handover.
